life-event.prepare.title: Prepare Anmeldung
life-event.prepare.subtitle: Atlas helps you prepare. The registration itself happens with your local authority.
life-event.prepare.status.blocked: Registration is blocked until you add a registrable address in your profile.
life-event.prepare.status.actionable: Address information is available. Anmeldung is not yet confirmed in Atlas.
life-event.prepare.status.actionableWith: Address information for {city} is available. Anmeldung is not yet confirmed in Atlas.
life-event.prepare.status.complete: You confirmed that Anmeldung is complete. Atlas treats Registration as complete.
life-event.prepare.whyBody: Anmeldung establishes your legal residence record. It is typically needed before tax ID, insurance paths, and many employment formalities can proceed smoothly.
life-event.prepare.whatBody: Anmeldung is the registration of your residence with the responsible local authority (often the Bürgeramt or Meldebehörde). Arrival Atlas does not perform this registration for you.
life-event.prepare.checklist.address: A registrable address and housing details you can confirm.
life-event.prepare.checklist.id: Valid identification documents required by the authority.
life-event.prepare.checklist.landlord: Landlord or housing confirmation if your locality requires it.
life-event.prepare.checklist.appointment: An appointment or visit process with the responsible office (requirements vary by locality).
life-event.prepare.checklistNote: Exact documents, fees, and deadlines depend on your local authority. Atlas does not invent city-specific requirements.
life-event.prepare.whereBody: The actual Anmeldung is handled by the responsible local authority outside Arrival Atlas.
life-event.prepare.externalDisclaimer: Opening external guidance does not mark Registration complete in Atlas.
life-event.prepare.officialGuidancePendi: An authoritative official guidance link is not configured in Atlas yet. Contact or search your local Bürgeramt / Meldebehörde for the process that applies to your address.
life-event.prepare.returnBody: After you complete Anmeldung with the authority, return here and explicitly confirm that you finished the external process.
life-event.prepare.confirmCompletion: I have completed Anmeldung — confirm in profile
life-event.registration.inspector.blocke: Registration is blocked because registrable address information is required first.
life-event.registration.inspector.action: Address information is complete. Anmeldung is not yet confirmed.
life-event.registration.inspector.nextPr: Next step: Prepare Anmeldung, then complete it externally and confirm here.
life-event.registration.inspector.noBloc: Address prerequisite is met. Anmeldung confirmation is still outstanding.
